description: This file defines an enumeration 'ThingsParameter' that specifies query parameters used in the things REST API of the Eclipse Ditto gateway service, including parameters for filtering by IDs and fields.

classes.name: ThingsParameter
classes.description: Enumeration of query parameters for the things REST API, providing constants 'IDS' and 'FIELDS' for filtering requests.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides Object.toString() to return the parameter value as a string.
